title: Case Matrix
prompt: Implement is_leap(year) (divisible by 4, except centuries unless divisible by 400). Then write TestLeap using subTest over at least 6 year/expected pairs including 2000, 1900, 2024, 2023. Assign the class to SUITE_TEST.

tests.name: leap logic correct
tests.code:
assert is_leap(2000) is True
assert is_leap(1900) is False
assert is_leap(2024) is True
assert is_leap(2023) is False

tests.name: subTest structure
tests.code:
import unittest, io
assert 'subTest' in code, 'use self.subTest in the suite'
result = unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=io.StringIO(), verbosity=0).run(unittest.TestLoader().loadTestsFromTestCase(SUITE_TEST))
assert result.wasSuccessful(), 'leap tests failed'
tests.hint: The test body must use self.subTest in a loop.

tests.name: at least 6 cases and all pass
tests.code:
import unittest, io
suite = unittest.TestLoader().loadTestsFromTestCase(SUITE_TEST)
result = unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=io.StringIO(), verbosity=0).run(suite)
assert result.wasSuccessful(), 'leap tests failed'
assert result.testsRun >= 1
tests.hint: Six+ cases including the four anchor years.
